english.note: Use this for physically holding up a structure or bearing a load.
Use this for physically holding something up or keeping it from collapsing.

examples.english: These steel pillars sustain the whole bridge.
examples.traditional: 呢幾根鋼柱支撐住成座大橋。
examples.jyutping: ni1 gei2 gan1 gong3 cyu5 zi1 caang1 zyu6 sing4 zo6 daai6 kiu4

examples.english: This pillar can support the whole bridge.
examples.traditional: 呢條柱可以支撐成座橋。
examples.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 cyu5 ho2 ji5 zi1 caang1 seng4 zo6 kiu4

english.note: Use 支撐 when a person or relationship gives someone emotional support and stability during distress.

examples.english: When times are hard, my friends anchor me.
examples.traditional: 困難嗰陣，朋友一直支撐住我。
examples.jyutping: kwan3 naan4 go2 zan6 pang4 jau5 jat1 zik6 zi1 caang1 zyu6 ngo5
